name: ReceiverAxelar spoofed expressExecute EYWA unlock
summary: ReceiverAxelar.expressExecute skipped Axelar gateway validation and trusted attacker-controlled sourceChain and sourceAddress, so the caller passed a spoofed receiveData payload that routed through PortalV2 into the CLP Portal and unlocked 999,787,453.0325354 EYWA to the caller in a single transaction.
notes: Directly deployed ReceiverAxelar runtime with the unvalidated expressExecute path since creation. No proxy code-selection path; the runtime hashes identically at deployment and immediately before the incident.

Exact receipt accounting: one EYWA Transfer of 999787453.0325354 from the CLP Portal 0xac8f44ceca92b2a4b30360e5bd3043850a0ffcbe to the caller, priced at the 2026-02-01 CoinGecko daily close. This record anchors the largest single drain of a Nomad-style multi-attacker campaign totaling about $2.9m across chains; the 99,988.74 EYWA dust to fee collector 0x4400671b in the same transaction is not counted. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas.
